policy_selection_gate.gate_description: All thresholds, persistence windows, escalation rules, cooldown/reset rules, and minimum observation requirements frozen strictly using 2024 validation data prior to test benchmark execution.

primary_metric_description: Alert decisions and risk tiers are evaluated exclusively on post-hoc isotonic calibrated probabilities fitted on the 2024 validation set. Raw Random Forest vote fractions are forbidden from triggering alerts or determining risk tiers.

bob.rationale: Suppresses single-day marine spikes while confirming persistent multi-day cyclogenetic preconditioning.

aras.rationale: Accounts for intermittent cloud/surface sampling gaps and shorter-lived Arabian Sea disturbances.

CRITICAL.action: Immediate maximum emergency advisory across all basins

HIGH.action: Immediate ALERT triggered on single day without requiring multi-day persistence

MODERATE.action: Initial WATCH (pending confirmation). Escalates to ALERT upon persistence fulfillment (2-consecutive for BoB, 2-of-3 for ArAs)

bob.description: De-escalates from ALERT to NO_ALERT only after 2 consecutive days below 0.15 calibrated probability.

aras.description: De-escalates from ALERT to NO_ALERT only after 2 consecutive days below 0.05 calibrated probability.

physical_integrity_checks: Depth must correspond to surface ocean layer (~0.494m)
Physical bounds valid for Copernicus variables (thetao, so, zos, mlotst, uo, vo)
Daily chronological ordering without missing timesteps in persistence window (missing timesteps reset rolling buffer)

validation_metrics.cyclones_detected: 1/2 (Depression ARB 01 detected; Cyclone Asna undetectable due to land origin at 23N vs 16.5N central site)

arabian_sea.undetectable_event_analysis: Cyclone Asna formed over land at 23.5°N in Gujarat/Rajasthan and only entered the Gulf of Kutch for 24h. The central Arabian Sea monitoring point (16.5°N) exhibited deep MLD (36m) and negative SST anomalies (-0.24°C), making it physically impossible to detect from ocean surface features at the central monitoring point.
